latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of drawio-flowchart: Production-quality, standards-driven .drawio flowchart generator.

- Generates structured, visually clean flowchart XML files for diagrams.net (draw.io), following a comprehensive set of design and formatting rules.
- Enforces swimlane stage organization, strict hierarchy, text sizing, color palette, and arrow routing for professional results.
- Output includes fully packaged .drawio XML with guidance on opening: via app.diagrams.net browser, desktop app, or VS Code extension.
- Includes a detailed validation checklist to ensure flowcharts meet usability and compatibility standards.
